decisions.statement: A draft is held to the bodies its writer read as a landing is.
A draft refused over a body that moved names the paths to read again rather than a drop.
One rule answers whether a landing and a draft are held to the bodies read.
A draft answers which paths the change it kept names.
A draft takes no hold over the worktree.
A draft writes no body the change carries into the worktree.
No check runs over a draft.
A draft is weighed against no importers.

definition: a change kept as an agent's edits rather than written onto the tree
